classification.difficultyReason: Identify and total the triangular tent's end, roof and floor areas, then apply the taught half-cylinder decomposition with radius half the width and compare the totals.

content.prompt: Which tent has the greater surface area? Include the floors. Give the difference to the nearest $0.1\text{ m}^2$.

spec.description: Triangular-prism tent with an isosceles front cross-section, dashed perpendicular altitude, right-angle marker, matching sloping-edge ticks and dashed hidden rear geometry. Ordinary source purple strokes are reconstructed in black.
spec.mathematics: Triangular end base 2 m, perpendicular height 2 m, equal sloping sides with supplied length 2.24 m, prism length 5 m. Both triangular ends, both sloping rectangles and the floor are included.
spec.answerVisibility: All measurements and marks are permanent givens; no calculated areas are shown.

spec.description: Half-cylinder tent with semicircular ends and a rectangular floor. The front vertical radius cue is dashed and meets the diameter at a right-angle marker. Rear hidden arc and floor geometry are dashed. Ordinary source purple strokes are reconstructed in black.
spec.mathematics: Diameter 2 m and length 5 m; radius is therefore 1 m. Include both semicircular ends, the half-cylinder curved surface and the rectangular floor.
spec.answerVisibility: Diameter, length and construction marks are permanent givens; radius and calculated areas are answer-only.

answer.short: The triangular prism tent has $7.6\text{ m}^2$ more surface area.
answer.worked:
Triangular prism tent, including the floor:
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{triangular}}&=2\left(\frac12\times2\times2\right)+2(2.24\times5)+2\times5\\A_{\text{triangular}}&=4+22.4+10\\A_{\text{triangular}}&=36.4\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
Half-cylinder tent, including both ends and the floor, with $r=1\text{ m}$:
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{half-cylinder}}&=2\left(\frac12\pi(1)^2\right)+\frac12\times2\pi(1)(5)+2\times5\\A_{\text{half-cylinder}}&=\pi+5\pi+10\\A_{\text{half-cylinder}}&=(10+6\pi)\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Difference}&=36.4-(10+6\pi)\\\text{Difference}&\approx7.6\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
The triangular prism tent has the greater surface area.
